newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MONACO COACH TIGANA LANDS FOUR-GAME SUSPENSION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO COACH TIGANA LANDS FOUR-GAME SUSPENSION.

text.p: Monaco coach Jean Tigana has been banned from the bench and the referee's dressing room for four games for insulting a match official, the French Football Federation said on Friday.
It said in a statement the ban was for insulting referee Laurent Duhamel after Monaco's French Cup first round match at second division Laval on January 17. Monaco lost the match 1-0.
